options.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math> - does not have <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></math> orbitals
Back bonding in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>NCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> is not possible

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math> atom is more electronegative so does not forms <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn></math> bonds

solution.text: Due to the absence of vacant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></math> orbitals nitrogen cannot form penta halides, so <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>NCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> is not formed but <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> is formed as phosphorous has vacant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></math> orbitals
